method: Viewed complete unchanged native Im4, Im3 and Im5. Used earlier candidate records as locators only; no new color predicate, interpolation, physical ordinate or discrepancy calculation. Local visual cues do not establish whole-curve continuity.

rejection_rule: Reject or revise a footprint that misses visible ink, overlaps an unresolved identity conflict, is hidden by composition, or admits another plausible identity. Preserve original proposals and separate reviewer corrections.

first_fragment_review.independence: Separate prior-informed AI reviewer sharing context; not human acceptance or blind recovery.
first_fragment_review.method: Reviewer inspected original-detail Im4 and complete composed page (display resized), and read raw neutral RGB values around both boxes without the previous detector predicate/component counts. Reviewer reports matching Im4 hash. Root separately viewed complete composed page.
first_fragment_review.solid_disposition: No correction proposed: visible dark route across native columns300-305 lies approximately at rows34-43 within the box. Left/right boundaries truncate a continuing stroke and are not physical endpoints.
first_fragment_review.dash_disposition: No correction proposed: one short visible dash principally at columns301-306, rows6-12 lies within the box; no competing route or same-color crossing identified inside it. Surrounding pattern and source legend support provisional local style.
first_fragment_review.limits: Pale JPEG deviations outside dark strokes remain. No exact ink mask, calibrated centreline uncertainty, admitted support or whole-route continuity is established.
first_fragment_review.decision: Retain both original proposals for continued inventory work. Do not upgrade to accepted measurements.
